_about: jarvis tuning — every gesture/camera number the stage reads at boot (GET /tuning). Fitted to THIS hand with the clinic (P sampler / K clinic / the tape). Edit, then `bin/board.sh '{"a":"reload"}'`. Missing keys fall back to the stage's built-in defaults (identical to these).

detector._: MediaPipe HandLandmarker confidences. detect = fresh detection (the busy-background ghost wall, 0.65); presence/track = keeping a hand once found (0.45: a marginal second hand, once found, is kept).

hands._: THE HANDS: identity + grace + smoothing. graceMs = how long a vanished hand stays a ghost (no tap/fling fires). gate = max wrist travel (normalized) to re-match an id. euro = One-Euro filter (minCutoff: lower = steadier at rest; beta: higher = sharper in motion). cursorLerp = the cursor's per-frame chase toward the pinch point (1 = raw). maxHands (Task 23): a WHOLE-FRAME cap, not per person — at 2 a guest sitting beside the owner competed for the same two slots and the owner lost a hand. 4 covers two people; each extra slot costs landmark work per frame.

pinch._: THE PINCH. Three admitting signatures (any one): CONTRAST (frontal OK-sign: backMean-f8 > contrast && backMean > backFloor), PROFILE (aspect < profileAspect && tRel > profileT), CURLED (this hand's natural pinch: tRel > curledT && aspect > curledAspect; clinic 2026-08-23: pinch t .64-.70/a 2.80-3.41 vs fist t .12-.52/a 2.06-2.63). Touch = 2D gap ratio under the ceiling (gapFrontal / gapRotated for aspect < profileAspect) OR THE WORLD LANE: metric thumb-tip/index-tip distance from MediaPipe's world landmarks under worldTouchCm centimetres (orientation-proof; 0 disables). Release: ratio >= relSlow, or relFast when the hand moves faster than fastSpd px/s (two frames running). emaBar = the charged-EMA admit bar. sanityAspect = palm aspect above which the hand is a hallucination.

tap._: a tap = pinch released within ms, travelling under px

fling._: a throw = peak pinch speed over peak px/s with follow-through >= follow of peak at release (fitted: deliberate fling 1526, casual release <= 128, attempts 447-579 @ 1920x1044)

claw._: force pull: the open-flash -> claw window, and how long the lit target strains before the snap unlocks

clap._: THE STRIKE READ: two upright (handUp > up) open hands closing at >= closing px/s, then both vanish

light._: THE LIGHT GOVERNOR. floor = raw hand-zone luma below which FAST is too dark to lift (-> LIGHT after darkMs); back = return to FAST when est. FAST luma > floor*back for brightMs; target/gainMax = the software lift; toneMax = highest ISP tone rung allowed (clinic verdict: 1).

tape._: THE TAPE: seconds of per-frame anatomy kept for `cmd dump`; raw = also keep the 21 raw landmarks + world gap per hand (what tools/replay.py replays)

owner._: THE OWNER LOCK. enabled=false turns the whole thing off (?lock=0 on the URL does the same for one launch). matchDist = face-api descriptor distance under which a face IS the owner (same person typically < 0.5; fit it with the D overlay's score). graceMs = how long the board stays open after the owner's face drops. livenessMs = a blink or head move must be this recent (anti-photo). 30s, not 8s: a person concentrating on a screen blinks every 15-20s, and 8s locked the user mid-read. A photo still never blinks and never micro-moves, so it locks after 30s. closeK = a second face counts as 'close' (guest candidate) within closeK x the owner's face width, centre to centre, enforced continuously. guestTimeoutMs = revoke an approved guest this long after they drift away / leave. handReach / spanMin / spanMax = hand-to-face assignment: wrist within handReach face widths of the face, hand span between spanMin..spanMax face widths. thumbsUpMs = hold a thumbs-up this long to approve. enrollMs = the first-boot auto-enroll window (one face, alone, attentive). geomTol = THE GEOMETRY GATE (Task 11): max mean relative difference between a face's iris-normalised bone-ratio vector and the enrolled one before it REJECTS an otherwise-matching descriptor (beard-proof; 0 disables the gate). driftMax = THE TEMPLATE DRIFT: a face this confidently-you (descriptor score under driftMax) is eligible to update the owner's stored descriptors. driftEveryMs = minimum gap between drift writes (0 disables drift). driftCap = the owner's vecs array never grows past this many descriptors. propTol = POSE-LINKED HANDS: how close a body's shoulderW/headW proportion must be to the owner's enrolled one to win a tied hand claim (tie-breaker only, never a rejection). GUESTS, ROUND 2 (Task 23): closeK is the tight radius to BECOME a guest candidate; guestKeepK is the wider radius an ALREADY-APPROVED guest is judged against, so they don't flicker guest/guest-away (and lose their hands) every time they shift in their seat. Both scale with the mean of the two face widths, not the owner's alone. guestMatchDist is the descriptor distance within which an approval follows a person across a face-id change (same units as matchDist).

face._: THE FACES (MediaPipe FaceLandmarker). everyNthFrame = run the face model every Nth video frame (the stage raises it to 2 by itself when hands+face inference exceeds the frame budget). idEveryMs = re-score each face's identity this often. graceMs = a vanished face stays listed this long. eyeOpenMin = eyes count as open above this (1 - max eyeBlink blendshape). blinkClose = eyes count as shut below this (a blink = shut then open within 600ms). 0.45, not 0.3: a fast blink only dips the eye-open signal partway, and at a low camera fps a full closure can fall between frames entirely. moveDeg = head pose change that counts as motion. attYaw/attPitch = the attention cone in degrees. graceMs raised 300 -> 1200 (Task 23): a face keeps its identity only while seen inside this window, and a guest approval hangs off that identity. At ~11 fps with faceEvery=2 the model runs every ~180ms, so ONE missed detection minted a new face id and silently dropped the guest's approval.

pose._: POSE-LINKED HANDS (Task 11 Part C, MediaPipe PoseLandmarker; Task 21 turned it on). enabled=true — the stage constructs the model and runs it beside hands+face. everyNthFrame = run the pose model every Nth video frame, starting point (the stage drops it to every 3rd itself under sustained frame-budget pressure, same hysteresis as THE FACES). wristTol = max normalized distance from a hand's wrist to a body's wrist for that body to claim the hand. visMin = THE FRAMING GATE (Task 21): a landmark's visibility (and presence, if the bundle exposes it) must clear this AND the point must actually land inside the frame (small margin) before js/pose.js calls it usable (`ok`) — MediaPipe invents off-frame joints instead of omitting them, so every derived value (shoulderW/headW/torso/prop) is null unless the landmarks behind it are ok. This is what makes whole-body, half/stomach-up, chest-up and shoulder-up framings all honest instead of guessing.

hands2._: THE TWO-SIDED SEARCH: when a frame comes back with fewer than 2 hands and a face is tracked, re-detect on a crop beside the face so the missing hand fills the model's input instead of a few pixels of a downscaled full frame. sideW/sideH = the region's size in face widths/heights. conf = detection confidence for the crop pass (lower than the full-frame wall is safe: the crop excludes the busy background). dedupe = wrist distance below which a rescued hand is the same as a full-frame hand. maxPerFrame = how many rescue detects one frame may run. everyNthFrame = only attempt a rescue every Nth frame (1 = every frame).

image3d._: Every staged image becomes a 3D luminance relief in a three.js scene (rotatable, rim-lit, bloom-catching) instead of a flat glass card. depth = how far the brightest pixels push out, in units of the plane's half-height. seg = mesh subdivision per side (cost: seg^2 verts). alphaCut = texels with alpha below this are discarded (transparent PNGs keep their silhouette). rim = fresnel edge glow strength. flat = force the old flat card. rimTint 'image' makes the rim glow in the picture's own dominant colour (use 'teal' for the fixed hologram tint); bloom = glow strength (the bloom no longer boosts saturation — neon art was being glowed twice); exposure = tone-mapping exposure for image scenes. emissive = how strongly the picture lights itself (keeps blacks black instead of the relief reading as grey stone).

scroll._: Real-time scrolling. gain = how far content moves per unit of hand travel. friction = momentum decay per second after release (lower = longer coast). minFlick = release speed below which momentum is not worth starting, px/s. stop = speed at which a coast ends, px/s. pdfAhead = how many pages either side of the visible box are kept rendered.

hud._: THE HUD (glass over the real desktop). mirror = how much of the camera self-view shows behind the glass, 0..1 — 0 is pure see-through, 1 is the old full mirror. M cycles it live in HUD mode and the choice is remembered per browser.

pointer._: THE POINTER FEEL. zone = the fraction of the camera frame that maps to the WHOLE screen; 0.62 means the middle 62% covers everything, so the hand travels ~1.6x less and the screen corners are reachable (1.0 = the old 1:1 mapping, where the edges could not be reached at all). lerp = pointer smoothing, separate from hands.cursorLerp because the calm smoothing that suits dragging cards reads as lag on a mouse; higher is more responsive. deadPx = ignore moves smaller than this. gesture (Task 29): the button is the THUMB moving toward the INDEX KNUCKLE — not toward a fingertip, which is unreachable when the other fingers are folded to hold the point, and which would also collide with the board's own tip-to-tip pinch test. tapIn/tapOut are that distance in span units, with hysteresis so a wobbling hand cannot chatter. holdMs = press longer than this and it becomes a DRAG instead of a click. doubleMs = two taps inside this window so the app sees a double-click. scrollPxPerClick = hand travel per wheel click. Which button a tap means comes from how many fingers are out: 1 = left, 2 = right, 3 = middle.

desks._: THE DESKS on the glass. openFull: the first desk card you open goes FULL SCREEN immediately (bar and frame dropped, body sized to the window's own aspect — on a 1920x1080 display showing a 1920x1044 window that is 1:1, no resampling). Set false to have desks open tiled on the glass instead, at roughly 70% of native. Toggle either way with Z, or bin/board.sh '{"a":"deskfull"}' — which is the dependable one, since the board is click-through and this i3 is focus_follows_mouse, so it often has no keyboard focus. tileW/tileH: a desk tile is fitted inside this fraction of the viewport, preserving the window's own aspect — so a portrait window becomes a tall narrow tile rather than one taller than the screen that then has to be scaled back down.
